'''334.556/G7''' was the designation of a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The commander was ordered to attack and hold the village called [[Chakton]] with a force of foot [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], although mechanized reinforcements were available.
